name: Odiot S.A.
summary: Odiot S.A. engages in the manufacture and sale of pieces and cutlery in silver, gold, and precious metals. The company offers cutleries, masterpieces, porcelain, crystal, decorative bowls, bestiaries, table accessories, and gifts. It also provides personalization, upkeep, and reparation services. The company was formerly known as Odiot Holding Société anonyme and changed its name to Odiot S.A. in May 2025. The company was founded in 1690 and is headquartered in Paris, France.
